title: Find a Value of a Mysterious Function Closest to Target
summary: Determine the closest value of a function applied to an array to a given target.
statement: Determine the closest value of a function applied to an array to a given target. Given an integer array and a target, find indices l and r such that the absolute difference between the function's output on the subarray defined by l and r, and the target, is minimized. Return this minimum difference.
constraints: For each non-empty contiguous subarray, func is the bitwise AND of all its values.
Return the minimum absolute difference between such a value and target.
hints: Track the distinct AND values of subarrays ending at the previous index.
At a new value, start a singleton and AND it with every previous ending value.
Measure every resulting value against target.
AND only clears bits, so duplicate states collapse and the set stays logarithmically small in the value range.
editorial: AND only clears bits, so duplicate states collapse and the set stays logarithmically small in the value range.

tests.explanation: A subarray AND can reach seven, whose distance from five is two.
The AND of adjacent distinct powers of two is zero, matching the target.
